b374adc858f965d2.title: Decoding the role of cellular senescence in wounds
digest: Studies that involve the direct manipulation of senescent cells, either by addition or elimination, in wound models have yielded conflicting results.
This inconsistency probably reflects the inherently dynamic nature of wound healing and the complexity of targeting cellular senescence.

1884f356c2d8aa3d.title: Age-related impairment of oncogenic surveillance promotes liver tumor initiation
digest: Using a mouse model of oncogene-induced senescence in hepatocytes, Yan, Zhu and colleagues report that aging weakens senescence immunosurveillance, enabling liver tumors lacking the initiating oncogene mutation.
Spp1+ macrophage depletion or senolytic treatment reduces tumor incidence in aged mice.

47895101717924e6.title: Opinion: Montana’s ‘right to try’ law makes patients responsible for bearing costs — and risks
digest: In July, Montana became the first state to license clinics to offer patients who are not terminally ill drugs and devices that the Food and Drug Administration has not approved.
” Critics say it lets patients, including medical tourists from other states, pay out of pocket for unproven therapies.

9fc93af9f08f57cc.title: Meridial – Senior Research Software Engineer – Image Processing
digest:
About Meridial
 
Meridial is a Focused Research Organisation (FRO) with a mission to bring connectomics into the living brain.
We are building a platform for longitudinal, synapse-resolution mapping of functional neural circuitry in preclinical models.

94fbac819a4f6fc7.title: ISOMPRA enables the disambiguation of transcriptional and post-transcriptional effects of genetic variants
digest: ISOMPRA is a new method for assessing transcriptional and post-transcriptional effects of regulatory elements in a massively parallel reporter assay.
This method can be used in vivo or in vitro to understand variants associated with disease.

79b2efd64591975f.title: In a fertility advance, engineered molecular glue stabilizes chromosomes in aging eggs
digest: Around the world, people are increasingly choosing to have babies later in life for reasons both social and economic.
As they get older though, they face a mounting biological challenge: genetic errors caused by chromosomes failing to separate correctly.

8d3a878fb3809e45.title: Aged natural killer cells get back into shape
digest: Aging natural killer (NK) cells might retain their killing machinery yet struggle to deploy it.

Liu and colleagues now link this defect to retinoid-associated lipid remodeling, and show that inhibiting fatty acyl chain elongation restores the mechanical features of NK cells that are essential for antitumor activity in preclinical models of human cancers.

cd42e7f5f3ccf369.title: E11 Bio - Research Associate, In Vivo
digest: E11 Bio is on a mission to advance connectomics towards whole brain scale for humans and other mammals.
We are a collaborative and interdisciplinary team of scientists and engineers engaged in a neuroscience moonshot project to develop a radical technology platform for scalable mammalian brain mapping.
